title: पृथ्वीराज चौहान
edition: पहिलो संस्करण वि.सं. २०४९; दोस्रो संस्करण वि.सं. २०६१
description: Devkota's epic (महाकाव्य) on Prithviraj Chauhan, in 21 cantos (सर्ग). Assembled from the per-canto pages on Kavita Kosh. Sajha Prakashan edition, ISBN 99933-2-510-4, 184 pp.

rights.basis: Author died 1959; Nepal's Copyright Act 2059 grants life + 50 years, expiring 2009. (Sajha's posthumous 1992 typeset edition carries an ISBN, but the underlying Devkota text is public domain.)
